title: waitingroom_additional_routes
description: Only available for the Waiting Room Advanced subscription. Additional hostname and path combinations to which this waiting room will be applied. There is an implied wildcard at the end of the path. The hostname and path combination must be unique to this and all other waiting rooms.

host.description: The hostname to which this waiting room will be applied (no wildcards). The hostname must be the primary domain, subdomain, or custom hostname (if using SSL for SaaS) of this zone. Please do not include the scheme (http:// or https://).

path.description: Sets the path within the host to enable the waiting room on. The waiting room will be enabled for all subpaths as well. If there are two waiting rooms on the same subpath, the waiting room for the most specific path will be chosen. Wildcards and query parameters are not supported.
